detailed_descriptions.en: Scawy Game is an absurd first-person parody horror game about Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer who buys a cheap asset house in the middle of nowhere to write his next book. He arrives with his daughter and dog. The house seems cheap, suspiciously familiar , and almost normal. It comes with one simple responsibility. Survive 4 days and 4 nights in the house, feed the cats, unlock bizarre skills, and try to defeat the entity hiding inside. ONE SIMPLE TASK: FEED THE CATS The previous owner had only one request before she died: feed her three cats every day. Find them. Feed them. Try not to question why one of them is named Chi Gevara. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING - Explore a suspiciously normal home - Complete strange objectives - Squeeze an inflatable chicken to reduce panic - Unlock bizarre skills - Survive 4 days and 4 nights - Try to defeat the entity hiding inside the house ( there's always one) HORROR, HUMOR, SARCASM, AND PARODY We like horror. We also like dumb jokes. Scawy Game combines both: sarcasm, parody, absurd situations, and scares that do not always work the way they should. Keep an open mind.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Scawy Game is an absurd first-person parody horror game about Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer who buys a cheap asset house in the middle of nowhere to write his next book.

He arrives with his daughter and dog.
The house seems cheap, suspiciously familiar, and almost normal.
It comes with one simple responsibility.


Survive 4 days and 4 nights in the house, feed the cats, unlock bizarre skills, and try to defeat the entity hiding inside.

ONE SIMPLE TASK: FEED THE CATS

The previous owner had only one request before she died: feed her three cats every day.
Find them.
Feed them.
Try not to question why one of them is named Chi Gevara.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING

- Explore a suspiciously normal home
- Complete strange objectives
- Squeeze an inflatable chicken to reduce panic
- Unlock bizarre skills
- Survive 4 days and 4 nights 
- Try to defeat the entity hiding inside the house (there's always one)

HORROR, HUMOR, SARCASM, AND PARODY

We like horror. We also like dumb jokes. Scawy Game combines both: sarcasm, parody, absurd situations, and scares that do not always work the way they should. Keep an open mind.
